title: Eleven Days, Eleven Hours, Four Hours of Nothing
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：trip　|　正文 372 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trip 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① trip was eleven days, and it was the only one my mother ever took, and she was sixty-one, and the trip cost eleven pounds. My father had said for thirty-one years that they would go, and in 1974 they went, and the ② trip to the coast took eleven hours in a coach that stopped eleven times.

She had not wanted to ③ go on a trip, which is the thing I have never understood; she said a ④ trip to the shop is a trip you can finish, and a holiday is not, and she had spent thirty-one years finishing things. A trip, she said, is only yours when it is finished. On the second day she took a ⑤ trip on the wet stone at the top of the beach, cut her knee, and would not say so for three days, and my father found out because she could not get into the sea.

She ⑥ tripped over the same step twice more, and the second time she laughed, which my father said was the only photograph he ever wanted and never got. What ⑦ tripped her up in the end, though, was not the stone at all: it was the sixth day, when the coach did not come, and she sat on a wall for four hours and said nothing.

In 1989 she ⑧ made a trip to the city alone, eleven miles, to see an exhibition of eleven photographs, and she came back on the last bus and said it had been the best day since 1974. The ⑨ trip she talked about for the rest of her life, however, was neither of those: it was a walk to the water with her own mother in 1931, eleven minutes each way, and she said she had never been further.

The ⑩ trip, as I now think of it, was not eleven days at all: it was the eleven hours on the coach, and the wet stone, and the wall, and the four hours of saying nothing. She died in 1998. My father said she had hated it. She had said, once, that a trip is not the place, it is the thing you cannot put down, and I have decided that both of them were right.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 旅行；旅程；出行
B. n. （出门办的）一趟事；跑一趟
D. v. 绊倒；被……绊（trip over ...）
E. v. 使绊倒；使出错（trip ... up）
F. 固定搭配：go on a trip 去旅行
G. 固定搭配：a trip to ... 一趟去……的旅行
H. 固定搭配：make a trip（to ...）跑一趟；出一趟门

items.q: the trip to the coast took eleven hours
She had not wanted to go on a trip
she said a trip to the shop is a trip
she took a trip on the wet stone
She tripped over the same step twice
What tripped her up in the end
she made a trip to the city alone
The trip she talked about for the rest
The trip, as I now think of it

answers.why: the trip 意为“旅行、旅程”，那次旅行一共十一天，是母亲一生唯一的一次。
a trip to the coast 意为“一趟去海边的旅行”，去海边的这趟旅行在一辆停了十一次的长途车上花了十一个钟头。
go on a trip 意为“去旅行”，她本来并不想去旅行，这是我始终不理解的地方。
a trip to the shop 意为“跑一趟商店、出门办的一趟事”，她说跑一趟商店是能做完的一趟事，而度假不是。
take a trip 意为“绊倒、失足”，第二天她在海滩顶上的湿石头上绊了一下，磕破了膝盖。
trip over ... 意为“被……绊倒”，她又被同一级台阶绊倒了两次。
trip ... up 意为“使绊倒、使出错”，最终让她垮下来的并不是那块石头，而是第六天车没来。
make a trip（to ...）意为“跑一趟、出一趟门”，1989 年她独自跑了一趟城里，十一英里，去看十一张照片的展览。
the trip 意为“旅行、出行”，她此后半生都在讲的旅行却不是这两趟。
the trip 意为“旅行”，如今我所理解的这趟旅行根本不是那十一天。
